title: Retained-column generators detect maps from the graded piece
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], $K$ an integer-indexed cochain complex, $I$ a bicomplex with complex index in $\mathbf Z$ and resolution index in $\mathbf N$ [def-sp-double-complex-total], and $b\in\mathbf Z$. Put $J=((\operatorname{mappedFunctor}(\mathrm{id})(I))^{\mathrm{flip}})$ using extension by zero [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation]. Let $\epsilon:K\to\operatorname{Tot}(J)$ be a chain map, let $C=\operatorname{Cone}(\epsilon)$ [lem-pur-quasi-iso-cone-acyclic], and let $F$ be a decreasing subcomplex filtration of $C$ [def-sp-filtration]. Write $u_t:K^{t+1}\to C^t$ and $v_t:\operatorname{Tot}(J)^t\to C^t$ for the cone inclusions. Assume that the degreewise image steps [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients] are $F^q C^t=(\operatorname{im}(u_t)\text{ if }q\le t+1\text{, else }0)+\sum_{s=\max(b,q)}^t\operatorname{im}(J^{t-s,s}\to\operatorname{Tot}(J)^t\xrightarrow{v_t} C^t)$, with an empty sum zero. Fix $p,m\in\mathbf Z$ with $p-1\le m$, and write $G=(\operatorname{gr}_F^p C)^m$ and $\pi:(F^pC)^m\to G$ for the quotient projection. Let $T$ be an object of $\mathcal A$ and $g,h:G\to T$ morphisms. Assume (1) for every $r\in\mathbf N$ with $r+p=m$ and every lift $l:I^{p,r}\to(F^pC)^m$ of the actual diagonal inclusion, $g\circ\pi\circ l=h\circ\pi\circ l$; (2) when $m+1=p$, for every lift $l:K^p\to(F^pC)^m$ of the cone source inclusion after its index identification, $g\circ\pi\circ l=h\circ\pi\circ l$. Then $g=h$. A lift means its composite with the step inclusion is the stated ambient inclusion, with the canonical extension identification for $I$. No column-vanishing assumption or bicomplex augmentation $a$ is needed.

proof.text: cancel the epic evaluated cokernel projection from step p. Its two composites agree on the K generator and on every diagonal generator of the finite image supremum describing that step. A diagonal index s>p factors through step p+1 and is killed by the cokernel projection. Index s=p has nonnegative resolution degree m-p, so the first hypothesis applies after extendXIso. Columns s

theorem cartanEilenberg_cone_graded_hom_ext
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vA} A]
    (K : CochainComplex A ℤ)
    (I : HomologicalComplex₂ A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (b : ℤ)
    (aug : K ⟶ (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).total
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (F : DecreasingFiltration (CochainComplex.mappingCone aug))
    (hF : ∀ p n : ℤ, F.complexStep p n =
        (if p ≤ n + 1 then imageSubobject
          ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl aug).v (n + 1) n (by omega)) else ⊥) ⊔
        (Finset.Icc (max b p) n).sup (fun s ↦ imageSubobject
          ((((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).ιTotalOrZero
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (n - s) s n ≫
              (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr aug).f n)))
    (p m : ℤ) (hm : p - 1 ≤ m)
    (T : A) (g h : (F.gradedPiece p).X m ⟶ T)
    (hI : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : (r : ℤ) + p = m)
      (l : (I.X p).X r ⟶ (F.step p : CochainComplex A ℤ).X m),
      l ≫ (F.step p).arrow.f m =
        (HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
          (((𝟭 A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (I.X p))
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := r) (i' := m - p)
          (by change (r : ℤ) = m - p; omega)).inv ≫
        (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).ιTotal
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (m - p) p m (by change (m - p) + p = m; omega) ≫
        (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr aug).f m →
        l ≫ (F.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (by omega)).f m ≫ g =
          l ≫ (F.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (by omega)).f m ≫ h)
    (hK : ∀ (hk : m + 1 = p)
      (l : K.X p ⟶ (F.step p : CochainComplex A ℤ).X m),
      l ≫ (F.step p).arrow.f m =
        (K.XIsoOfEq hk.symm).hom ≫
        (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl aug).v (m + 1) m (by omega) →
        l ≫ (F.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (by omega)).f m ≫ g =
          l ≫ (F.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (by omega)).f m ≫ h) :
    g = h
